newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Horse racing-Runners and riders for Melbourne Cup.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Horse racing-Runners and riders for Melbourne Cup.

text.p: Following are the runners and riders for Tuesday's Melbourne Cup, a group one handicap for three-year-olds and upwards, value to winner A$1.43 million ($1.13 million). Tabulate under form, horse, trainer, jockey, weight in kgs, draw (low and middle numbers have advantage):
3005 COUNT CHIVAS (D Freedman) S King 57.0 (14) 33X2 COURT OF HONOUR (P Chapple-Hyam in England) S Marshall 56.5 (17)
1413 OSCAR SCHINDLER (K Prendergast in Ireland) M Kinane 56.5 (12)
4514 GREY SHOT (I Balding in England) P Eddery 55.0 (13)
2297 NOTHIN' LEICA DANE (G Waterhouse) R Dye 55.0 (9)
2400 THE PHANTOM CHANCE (J Wheeler) P Payne (53.0 (23)
1102 THE BANDETTE (J Wheeler in New Zealand) N Harris 51.0 (21)
7124 CIRCLES OF GOLD (B Smith) B Prebble 50.5 (7)
2521 FEW ARE CHOSEN (G Waterhouse) D Gauci 50.5 (22)
1903 MY KIWI GOLD (J Cummings) J Marshall 49.5 (16)
* - Crying Game and Magnet Bay were scratched on Tuesday morning through injury.
